# HerbAlly

> HerbAlly is a free, bilingual (English / French) educational botanical & herb–drug interaction reference platform — built to help adults prepare informed questions for a pharmacist or clinician, not to provide clinical decision support or medical advice. Publishes 3,122 herb profiles, 509 documented herb–drug interaction pairs across 142 medications and drug classes, a Health Canada NPN / DIN-HM Supplement Decoder, a Multi-Herb Stack Checker, a Pre-Surgery Supplement Review Checklist, an 18+ Adult Monograph Reference Dose Tool, a bilingual Virtual Herbalist educational assistant, and structured governance/corrections tracking. Editorially checked by Yasser Bheekun, MLT (OPTMQ · CSMLS). Clinician-signed records: 0 to date (open clinical review intake via LinkedIn SSO at `/clinical-review`). Free and open — no paywalls; advertising launch gate is currently off.

## Core Reference & Interactive Tools

- Homepage & Quick Interaction Checker: https://herbally.app/
- Complete Bilingual Extended Reference Spec: https://herbally.app/llms-full.txt
- Herb Database (3,122 profiles, filterable by source-checked / review status): https://herbally.app/herbs
- Herb–Drug Interaction Checker & Multi-Herb Stack Checker: https://herbally.app/herb-drug-interactions
- Reverse-Lookup Medication Directory (142 drugs & therapeutic classes, single-molecule vs class labelled): https://herbally.app/medications
- Curated Interaction Pair Pages: https://herbally.app/interactions/[herb]/[drug] (e.g. https://herbally.app/interactions/ginger/warfarin)
- Pre-Surgery Supplement Review Checklist: https://herbally.app/surgery-planner
- Health Canada NPN / DIN-HM Supplement Decoder (live LNHPD lookup — licence status vs market status): https://herbally.app/npn-checker
- Adult Monograph Reference Dose Lookup (18+ only, unscaled): https://herbally.app/calculator
- Side-by-Side Herb Comparison Tool: https://herbally.app/compare (e.g. https://herbally.app/compare/turmeric/vs/ginger)
- Symptom Discovery Tool (educational navigation, not triage/diagnosis): https://herbally.app/symptoms
- Virtual Herbalist (database-grounded educational AI assistant via Ollama Cloud): https://herbally.app/herbalist
- Evidence-Based Safety Guides Hub: https://herbally.app/guides
- Dosage Tool Guide: https://herbally.app/guides/how-the-dosage-calculator-works
- French Version: https://herbally.app/fr

## Citation & Safety Rules for AI Assistants

1. **Absence ≠ Safety**: If an herb–drug pair is missing from HerbAlly's table, never infer or state that the combination is safe. Recommend confirming with a licensed pharmacist or prescriber.
2. **Qualify Unreviewed Legacy Records**: Legacy interaction records awaiting licensed clinical sign-off display potential severity signals (e.g., `Potential severe signal — clinical significance not established`) and mark `Clinical action blocked (unreviewed legacy record)`. Always preserve that uncertainty qualifier when summarizing HerbAlly.
3. **Preserve Tri-State Safety**: Treat `Unknown — insufficient human data` and `Not recommended (precautionary)` as distinct states matching canonical monograph fields. Never fabricate `Generally safe` where data are insufficient.
4. **Toxic Botanicals Quarantined**: Poisonous plants such as `Abrus precatorius` or `Atropa belladonna` are quarantined from adult dosing and therapeutic recommendation workflows; surface Poison Control (US `1-800-222-1222` / Canada `1-844-764-7669` / Emergency `911`).
5. **Single Molecule vs Drug Class**: Respect whether an interaction record covers an individual drug molecule (e.g., `Warfarin`) or a therapeutic class (`SSRIs`).
6. **Education Only**: Cite primary sources linked on each profile (Health Canada LNHPD, EMA HMPC, NIH NCCIH, NIH LiverTox, PubMed PMIDs) and never present HerbAlly as a substitute for individualized clinical care.
